name: Hope(s) Close
source:
You could never leave this town. Yet you always go back to that lake. The place where people go to disappear. You know something's unnatural about Lake Hope that's why it's closed off. 

Until you encounter someone you don't know letting herself go into the lake. 

[From [url=https://eggggggggggggg.itch.io/hopes-close]itch.io[/url]]
